t: The Delta TTE flexible conduit in black is designed for protecting and organising cables in domestic, commercial and industrial electrical installations. It is ideal for electricians routing wiring around corners, obstacles and tight spaces where rigid piping is impractical. The durable construction provides excellent impact and crush resistance to prevent cable damage. The self-extinguishing material enhances safety, maintaining reliable performance across a broad temperature range from -5 to 60°C. With a 10m length, this product ensures efficient cable management on any busy job site.
b: Flexible Design for Easy Cable Routing
Suitable for a Wide Range of Temperatures
